output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's balance to any arbitrary value. This can be exploited to achieve unexpected exchange rate between the token and ether.

The mintToken function has a wrong logic in mintedAmount. The initialSupply is added to the mintedAmount, allowing the owner to set the totalSupply to any arbitrary value. This can be exploited to achieve unexpected exchange rate between the token and ether.
